To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the performance of TAR is improved by increasing the spacing of stack used in refrigeration section.
The experimental investigation of TAR driven by TAPM is a new approach to improve the performance of TAR.
the performance of thermo acoustic refrigerator (TAR), driven by a twin thermoacoustic primemover (TAPM), is strongly influenced by the thickness of the Mylar sheet.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an efficient thermoacoustic refrigerator.
the design of an efficient TAR driven by a twin TAPM.
the design, fabrication and testing of a thermoacoustically driven refrigeration system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the experimental investigation of thermoacoustic prime movers and refrigerators has been performed.
the present study is the first of its kind to investigate the performance of TAR driven by twin TAPM at 1 MP a pressure.
the twin thermoacoustic engine is an excellent prime mover for thermoacoustic refrigeration.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated a thermoacoustic driven refrigerator that has a COP congruent to 1.0 and a cooling capacity of 0.1 W.
the TAR driven by TAPM can be used as a cooling device for various applications.
the TAR can work efficiently at high pressure with low thermal conductivity stack.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of two thermoacoustic prime movers in tandem can drive a thermoacoustic refrigeration system efficiently.

the thermoacoustic refrigerator has the ability to produce low temperature difference across stack with low thermal conductivity materials like photographic film and Mylar sheets and it can be driven by a standing acoustic wave generated from TAPM.
the twin thermoacoustic heat pump is a very effective driver of a thermoacouustic refrigerator.
